title: Dream Jail. Are we in it?
content: A few years it’s been, since I could easily lucid dream. I developed a method of doing some things which enabled me to sort of jolt myself awake into a lucid state on a routine basis. I also was a routine sufferer of sleep paralysis for at least 10 years. I say was because I haven’t had an episode in a little over a year now. One of the last times I did was crazy. Over the years I trained myself to overcome the paralysis part and fight the “demon”. Basically just kicking and waving my arms (at least in my mind, in my dreams). The goal was to eventually override the paralysis effect and thus end the feeling of terror. One night I finally broke through paralysis and I saw this weird shape that I could only interpret as some kind of face, maybe digital in nature it’s hard to describe. More like a moving painting. That probably sounds ridiculous too lol but it’s very difficult to put into words I know. Anyways I apparently screamed bloody murder and burst through my door into the hallway still screaming until I was stopped. I remember only pure fear, like I was terrified out of my mind but it wasn’t for any particular reason. Just like I was “filled” with the emotion of fear without any causality. Keep in mind this whole time my mindset was, “I am stronger than you, you can’t control me”. I wasn’t letting any potential entity have control over me. I was making sure my mental state said F you to anything that wanted to manipulate me. After that I experienced 2 more very minuscule sleep paralysis episodes. Over quickly without a fuss. Haven’t experienced one since. But I HAVE experienced almost nothing but what appears to be mallworld. Are we being placed here because we are a threat? If so what are they so afraid of? Do we have the power of GODS? And have yet to realize it?
